answer_1.quote: we introduce FlashAudio, a text-to-audio generation model using rectified flows to learn straight flows for fast and high-fidelity output.

answer_2.quote: Objective assessment includes Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, Frechet audio distance (FAD), and CLAP score to quantify audio quality. The Real-time Factor (RTF) is also introduced to measure the system's efficiency...

answer_4.quote: In terms of subjective evaluation, we conduct crowd-sourced human assessments employing the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) to evaluate both audio quality (MOS-Q) and text-audio alignment faithfulness (MOS-F).
answer_4.guideline: For MOS-Q, evaluators were directed to 'concentrate on quality and naturalness of the audio.' For MOS-F, evaluators were asked 'Does the natural language description align with the audio?' and selected from options on a Likert scale.
